# 2 Clement — Chapter 15 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Alexandrinus, 2 Clement 15
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. The advice I have given you about self-control is not trivial. Anyone who follows it will never regret it — and it will save both the person who receives it and the person who gave it.
2. There is no small reward in bringing back a wandering, perishing soul and bringing it to salvation.
3. This is the repayment we owe to the God who made us — if both speaker and listener bring faith and love to the exchange.
4. So let us hold firm to what we have believed, living rightly and justly. Let us not waver, and let us not allow our hearts to drift toward empty things.
5. When we do good wholeheartedly, God will come after us with his gifts — "a measure pressed down, shaken together, running over." Think of what that means! For every seed we plant, he promises a harvest like that.
6. Let us keep practicing purity of heart, so we will not be condemned. The Lord himself says: "I will never tire of urging you — I want to save you."
